FAQ

Job inquiries

Share your portfolio and why you're interested in joining us at jobs@studiofreight.com. Please use "Job Inquiry: Role" as the subject line.

Press inquiries

Looking to say mean things? Right this way please. Looking to say nice things about Studio Freight? Reach out to press@studiofreight.com.

Collaboration inquiries

Let’s do things together. If you’re interested in collaborating on a project or event, hit us with your wild ideas at hello@studiofreight.com.

Food recommendations

If you’re in Columbus, hit up Fiery Sky and Gene's. In New York City, check out Bangkok Supper Club and Cosme. In Mexico City, don’t miss Kill Bill and Pujol. In Los Angeles, stop by Leo's Taco Food Truck and Bestia. In Margate, pop into High Dive and Pomus.

Book recommendations

For design, The Vignelli Cannon and Design as Art. For history, A Little Devil in America and The Bomber Mafia. For business, Martha INC and Unreasonable Hospitality. For wisdom, White and Bird by Bird. For book club, The Alchemist and Postcards from the Edge.
